BLUEPRINT:1,30,6003,2103,3009,0,0,0,639302525061926057,0.10.35.29151,Everything%20Farm%204,,,,This%20is%20the%204th%20in%20the%20%22Everything%20Farm%22%20series%20of%20BPs.%20It%20requires%20the%20300%20facility%20blueprint%20tech%20and%20super%20magnetic%20field%20generator%20tech%20due%20to%20the%20way%20belts%20are%20utlilized.%20The%20BP%20will%20attempt%20to%20make%20organic%20crystals%20from%20the%20plant%20fuel%20and%20logs%20drops%20in%20order%20to%20then%20make%20additional%20titanium%20crystals%20for%20yellow%20science.%20If%20you%20want%20to%20leverage%20that%2C%20you%27ll%20need%20to%20ship%20in%20water%20via%20logistics%20bot.%20That%27s%20impossible%20to%20BP%20given%20that%20water%20for%20every%20planet%20is%20different.%20%0A%0ABe%20aware%20that%20drops%20won%27t%20show%20up%20in%20the%20BAB%20filter%20until%20you%20have%20researched%20it.%20So%20if%20you%27re%20wondering%20why%20you%20aren%27t%20seeing%20titanium%20ingots%20or%20titanium%20crystals%20in%20the%20loot%20pool%2C%20make%20sure%20you%20have%20them%20researched%20in%20the%20tech%20tree.%20%0A%0AThe%20PLS%20do%20not%20have%20ships%20auto-set%20so%20you%27ll%20need%20to%20manually%20add%20them%20if%20you%20want%20them.%20""566E9F42062DC457D3F4F9A5FB80F37B
